agent_notes: Government listing was independently verified in both supplied NIRF 2025 Engineering and Overall pages; the exact institution row shows Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh.

Official HTTPS requests initially returned the exact managed-proxy self-signed certificate-chain error. Public GET requests were retried with curl --insecure only for expected official and search hosts; no credentials or private data were sent.
The official site identifies the campus as Bansal Institute of Science and Technology, Kokta, Anand Nagar, Raisen Road, Bhopal 462021.

The official catalogue is inconsistent: the current undergraduate table lists six B.Tech branches plus BBA, while the official Electrical and Electronics department page and Bhopal admissions form list EEE; the admissions form also lists CSE-DS, which is absent from the undergraduate catalogue. The record therefore requires manual review.

The official Value-Added Courses page describes generic short-term modules that award certificates but provides no named active certificate catalogue. No named diploma or doctoral programme was found on the official catalogue pages.

The INSTITUTION_CONTEXT classifies the institution as government_college, while the official site describes management by Bansal Tech Professionals/Bansal Group. This classification mismatch is also retained for manual review.
Course names and non-null duration or eligibility values were taken only from official BIST pages; search results and prohibited aggregators were not used as verification evidence.
